name: scene-defaults
citation: Starting values for the viewer's scene; see each field's note. Not physiological constants except ipdMm.
ipdNote: Spec §4.4 default interpupillary distance (a typical adult value); not transcribed from a population source.
ageNote: Starting subject age; a choice inside the Anderson 2008 range where accommodation is ample.
luminanceNote: Starting field luminance (typical indoor photopic); unused until the M3 pupil model.
targetDistanceNote: Starting target distance (a distant chart, 0.17 D of demand).
